name: Improved Metamorphosis [Psionic]
body:
You gain more versatility when changing your form.

Prerequisite: Ability to manifest minor metamorphosis, metamorphosis, major metamorphosis, or true metamorphosis.

Benefit: Any time you manifest minor metamorphosis, metamorphosis, major metamorphosis, or true metamorphosis, you gain one additional menu option from either the Ability Menu or Enhancement Menu of the relevant power.
